name: FAUCET
description: An OpenFlow controller for multi-table OpenFlow 1.3 switches implementing layer 2 switching, VLANs, ACLs, and layer 3 IPv4/IPv6 routing. Hardware-agnostic design with YAML-based configuration.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Includes Dockerfile.faucet, Dockerfile.gauge, Dockerfile.tests, Dockerfile.fuzz-config, Dockerfile.fuzz-packet, and docker-compose.yaml for orchestrated multi-container deployment.

eval_notes: Actively maintained, production-quality SDN controller with excellent Docker support. YAML-based config makes it easy to define network scenarios programmatically. Includes fuzzing containers for testing. Integrates with Prometheus for monitoring.
